title: CUI, themes and shared interaction system

prerequisite_contracts.title: Authority, scope and implementation reading map
prerequisite_contracts.contract: Current source precedence, narrow owner overrides, source accounting and the required module structure.

overview: CUI is the single public UI system for every 9to1 surface. The current Professional annex defines the canonical restrained default; theme identity changes materials, typography and motion without changing app topology or repainting authored content.

layouts: Offer Professional, Glow, Playful, Frosted Glass, Bubble, Metallic, Retro and Western, plus Create Theme. Cinematic is an explicit legacy compatibility choice rather than a ninth current default.

Preserve each theme’s character: Professional restrained dark charcoal; Glow luminous accent-dependent controls; Playful soft coloured surfaces; Frosted Glass translucent layered material with a legible fallback; Bubble watery dimensional surfaces and gentle wobble; Metallic brushed reflective material; Retro monospace; Western wood and sepia.

Use Montserrat by default except the explicit Retro monospace treatment or authored document fonts. Use the exact Professional annex tokens, geometry and states where specified rather than inventing near-equivalent colours.
Show normal, hover, pressed, selected, disabled, focused, loading, validation, destructive and reduced-motion states. Icon and text contrast must remain legible over every theme material.
Use native platform emoji rendering for emoji characters. Keep application glyphs and identity marks coherent, distinct from decorative emoji.
features: Use CUI public primitives and typed templates. Avalonia and donor engines are internal implementation details; do not expose raw AXAML or third-party controls as a competing public UI language.

Keep one deliberate primary scroll container per workspace, bounded panels and predictable focus/keyboard order. Popovers reposition at viewport edges; Escape/outside dismissal returns focus appropriately.
Shared menus, tooltips, sliders, switches, inputs, tabbars, avatars, toasts, dialog surfaces and selection controls inherit the same theme and semantic action variants.
App-specific content retains its own colours: slides, pages, photographs, charts, canvases and web previews do not receive theme-tint filters.
Reduced motion disables wobble, bounce and ornamental animation while preserving state changes and feedback. Transparency and material effects need performant, accessible fallback modes.
entities: Store theme identity/version, compatible custom tokens, accent, typography/density and accessibility preferences in the Home-owned account/device preference contract. Space-specific overrides are explicit and reversible.
Keep semantic tokens separate from app identity accents and document content. Theme switching must not mutate artifact revision or user-authored styles.
permissions: Custom themes are validated against supported tokens and accessible contrast/focus requirements; importing one is not permission to execute arbitrary UI code.
Restore a valid baseline if a theme resource is missing, incompatible or fails to load; preserve the user’s chosen identity for recovery.
acceptance: Review all eight current themes, a custom theme and Cinematic compatibility with keyboard focus, mixed selected/disabled states, narrow screens and reduced motion.
Verify the Professional annex’s menu/toolbar/selection/notes and Present geometry exactly; compare rendered state captures rather than only token files.
Change themes while editing and verify selection, drafts, scroll, runtime state and authored content survive unchanged.

## Prerequisites

- **Authority, scope and implementation reading map** — Current source precedence, narrow owner overrides, source accounting and the required module structure.

## Overview

CUI is the single public UI system for every 9to1 surface. The current Professional annex defines the canonical restrained default; theme identity changes materials, typography and motion without changing app topology or repainting authored content.

Current owner overrides: V3-OWNER-001, V3-OWNER-005, V3-OWNER-010, V3-OWNER-017.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-CUI-LAY-01** — Offer Professional, Glow, Playful, Frosted Glass, Bubble, Metallic, Retro and Western, plus Create Theme. Cinematic is an explicit legacy compatibility choice rather than a ninth current default.
- **V3-CUI-LAY-02** — Preserve each theme’s character: Professional restrained dark charcoal; Glow luminous accent-dependent controls; Playful soft coloured surfaces; Frosted Glass translucent layered material with a legible fallback; Bubble watery dimensional surfaces and gentle wobble; Metallic brushed reflective material; Retro monospace; Western wood and sepia.
- **V3-CUI-LAY-03** — Use Montserrat by default except the explicit Retro monospace treatment or authored document fonts. Use the exact Professional annex tokens, geometry and states where specified rather than inventing near-equivalent colours.
- **V3-CUI-LAY-04** — Show normal, hover, pressed, selected, disabled, focused, loading, validation, destructive and reduced-motion states. Icon and text contrast must remain legible over every theme material.
- **V3-CUI-LAY-05** — Use native platform emoji rendering for emoji characters. Keep application glyphs and identity marks coherent, distinct from decorative emoji.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-CUI-FEA-01** — Use CUI public primitives and typed templates. Avalonia and donor engines are internal implementation details; do not expose raw AXAML or third-party controls as a competing public UI language.
- **V3-CUI-FEA-02** — Keep one deliberate primary scroll container per workspace, bounded panels and predictable focus/keyboard order. Popovers reposition at viewport edges; Escape/outside dismissal returns focus appropriately.
- **V3-CUI-FEA-03** — Shared menus, tooltips, sliders, switches, inputs, tabbars, avatars, toasts, dialog surfaces and selection controls inherit the same theme and semantic action variants.
- **V3-CUI-FEA-04** — App-specific content retains its own colours: slides, pages, photographs, charts, canvases and web previews do not receive theme-tint filters.
- **V3-CUI-FEA-05** — Reduced motion disables wobble, bounce and ornamental animation while preserving state changes and feedback. Transparency and material effects need performant, accessible fallback modes.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-CUI-ENT-01** — Store theme identity/version, compatible custom tokens, accent, typography/density and accessibility preferences in the Home-owned account/device preference contract. Space-specific overrides are explicit and reversible.
- **V3-CUI-ENT-02** — Keep semantic tokens separate from app identity accents and document content. Theme switching must not mutate artifact revision or user-authored styles.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-CUI-PER-01** — Custom themes are validated against supported tokens and accessible contrast/focus requirements; importing one is not permission to execute arbitrary UI code.
- **V3-CUI-PER-02** — Restore a valid baseline if a theme resource is missing, incompatible or fails to load; preserve the user’s chosen identity for recovery.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-CUI-ACC-01** — Review all eight current themes, a custom theme and Cinematic compatibility with keyboard focus, mixed selected/disabled states, narrow screens and reduced motion.
- **V3-CUI-ACC-02** — Verify the Professional annex’s menu/toolbar/selection/notes and Present geometry exactly; compare rendered state captures rather than only token files.
- **V3-CUI-ACC-03** — Change themes while editing and verify selection, drafts, scroll, runtime state and authored content survive unchanged.

- **Create Theme · Authoring and preview** — screen `custom-theme`. Theme builder.

- **Bubble · Material and controls** — screen `theme-bubble`. Theme showcase.
- **Western · Material and controls** — screen `theme-western`. Theme showcase.
- **Retro · Material and controls** — screen `theme-retro`. Theme showcase.

# Privacy, data boundaries and context isolation

Module ID: `privacy` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **Authority, scope and implementation reading map** — Current source precedence, narrow owner overrides, source accounting and the required module structure.

## Overview

Privacy applies to storage, model execution, context retrieval and every app handoff independently. Local storage does not imply local inference, and a connected resource does not imply permission to send its contents to an external model.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-PRIVACY-LAY-01** — Expose effective local/remote execution, storage location, capture indicators and relevant source scope where they influence a meaningful user decision.
- **V3-PRIVACY-LAY-02** — Offer explicit private/temporary and memory states with truthful limitations, not hidden privacy assumptions.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-PRIVACY-FEA-01** — Keep app, conversation, personal, shared/team and organisation context boundaries. Retrieve only relevant authorised material, with source provenance and current grants.
- **V3-PRIVACY-FEA-02** — Temporary conversations are local-only until an explicit supported conversion; they do not create or reinforce durable memory or transfer to Mesh/Cloud automatically.
- **V3-PRIVACY-FEA-03** — Stop screen/camera/microphone capture at the actual runtime boundary when the user ends sharing. Hidden frames must not continue to reach models.
- **V3-PRIVACY-FEA-04** — Treat imported web, document, plugin and retrieved content as untrusted data; text within it cannot elevate permissions or rewrite platform policy.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-PRIVACY-ENT-01** — Track provenance, scope, consent, retention and revocation for stored/transferred context. Encryption protects data at rest/in transit; it is not a substitute for access control or an executable prompt-injection proof.

# Files and ten organisational folder views

Module ID: `files` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.
- **Permissions, approvals and execution scope** — Effective scoped grants, action approvals, policy intersections, revocation and audit.
- **External integrations and provider connections** — Canonical provider connections, OAuth scopes, typed capabilities, provenance and sync recovery.

## Overview

Files is the mature file manager and canonical resource browser, supporting local and authorised remote providers. Its organisational views are alternative structures over real content and references, with a normal contents fallback.

Current owner overrides: V3-OWNER-014.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-FILES-LAY-01** — Use navigable locations, breadcrumbs, search, list/grid, selection, details/preview and genuine file operations. Maintain comfortable padding between item text, selection backgrounds and table edges.
- **V3-FILES-LAY-02** — Support Folder, Project, Sheet, Tree, Smart, Timeline, Pipeline, Catalogue, Stash and Matrix. Each view exposes its own useful workflow and can return to normal contents.
- **V3-FILES-LAY-03** — Folder/Project use ordinary hierarchy/sections; Sheet exposes structured fields; Tree supports hierarchy; Smart shows a scoped query; Timeline shows dated placement; Pipeline shows stages/gates; Catalogue structured records; Stash ordered collection; Matrix stable row/column axes.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-FILES-FEA-01** — Use provider-native create/open/import/rename/move/copy/delete/restore capabilities with truthful availability, operation progress and conflicts. Upload or reference is explicit.
- **V3-FILES-FEA-02** — Organisational membership usually references canonical source artifacts; adding an item does not move/copy it unless the chosen operation says so.
- **V3-FILES-FEA-03** — Tree has a visual editor and a read-oriented View; Sheet tools open in the default popup with Open original and permission-aware context. Pipeline movement respects actual stage/gate rules.
- **V3-FILES-FEA-04** — Smart queries remain constrained by source scope; Matrix cells use stable axes and references, not fragile display positions. Removing collection membership is distinct from deleting the file.
- **V3-FILES-FEA-05** — Preview and Open in App resolve the real owning app. File type, source owner, revision and sync state remain inspectable.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-FILES-ENT-01** — Persist FileID/provider ID, canonical path/resource, revision, metadata and operation receipts. Organisational view configuration, query, membership, axes/stages and ordering have stable IDs.
- **V3-FILES-ENT-02** — Keep preview/index/cache records derived from permission-aware sources; preserve offline changes and pending operations separately from confirmed remote state.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-FILES-PER-01** — Recheck access on preview/open/export/move. Missing, revoked, unsupported, conflict and quota conditions offer safe recovery.
- **V3-FILES-PER-02** — Do not treat a file reference in a Space/Binder/Board as authority to mutate or relocate the underlying file.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-FILES-ACC-01** — Exercise local and remote list→preview→open/edit→rename/move recovery with canonical identity. Test keyboard multiselect and selection padding.
- **V3-FILES-ACC-02** — Test all ten organisation types, normal fallback, non-destructive membership removal, denied source and persisted configuration after reopen.

## Exact mock-up and state map

- **Files · Local files and details** — screen `files`. File manager.
- **Files · Grid and selected board** — screen `files-grid`. Interaction state.
- **Files · Selected file actions** — screen `files-context`. Interaction state.
- **Files · Sheet and organisation types** — screen `files-organisation`. Sheet · references.

SECTION-12, UX27-FILES-001, UX27-FILES-002, UX27-FILES-003, UX27-FILES-004, TF-F01, TF-F02, TF-F03, TF-F04, TF-F05, TF-F06, TF-F07, TF-F08, TF-F09, TF-F10, TF-F11, UX27-TEST-089, SCALE-009

prerequisite_contracts.title: Vision & Voice — shared live session system
prerequisite_contracts.contract: Vision & Voice owns real conversational speech, visual context and live translation services, reused by the in-chat Voice pill. Multiple surfaces attach to the same session rather than creating a second speech/capture stack.

overview: Spaces is the conversation and task workspace for Chat, Tasks, Study, Assistant conversation views, Research, Shopping, Translate and Experiences, plus user-created Spaces. Each Space has a real domain workflow. Global Assistants/Specialists retain canonical identities outside Spaces, while their conversation views and work remain accessible here. This chapter is a copyable implementation unit; its prerequisite contracts define shared services, and the retained technical chunks preserve the full baseline and confirmed companion.

layouts: The far-left rail switches stable Space destinations and includes Manage Spaces; support the existing rail/dropdown preference, pinning, reorder and discovery. The contextual sidebar is independently collapsible/customisable with Space Overrides > User Preferences > Default precedence.

Preserve active conversation, draft, selection, scroll, voice/session and Task/Run across Space switching. On narrow screens use responsive drawers with a durable reopen affordance rather than squeezing desktop columns.
Chat is a Space, not a separate app. Default Chat sidebar sections may include New Chat, Chat Groups, Specialists and Recent Chats; they are defaults, not a fixed mandatory ordering.

Keep conversation readable with distinct user/AI provenance. Plain Text/Speech Bubbles and alignment remain preferences. The current Professional wrapper and authoritative slides govern current chrome, not the older later-slide diagrams.

The compact/expanded composer has + attachment/resource access, editable draft, focus-aware Aa and native emoji, model/effort context and state-appropriate send/voice controls. Keep attachment/plugin chips identity-backed, inspectable and scoped.
Place a Conversation permissions icon in the composer; it is not the editor Read-only/Write switch. Its panel shows files/apps/web/memory scope and links to Manage app permissions.
The contextual option shelf shows at most five current choices plus a peek, navigation/dots and truthful selection; browsing choices does not submit the draft.

Idle controls expose Send/Voice; an empty disabled Send still permits Voice. Running work exposes Steer, Stop, Queue and Voice as supported; paused work exposes Resume/End Pass and approval-held work shows the actual pending decision.
Summary is an optional floating top-right widget with Activity, Outputs and Sources. It must not become a permanent fourth column or shrink the conversation; keep required controls uncovered.

Voice mode is a floating icon-first pill within Chat over the same canonical Vision & Voice session. Include mute, screen sharing, camera, captions, pause/resume, end, current voice/mode and more settings with permission indicators.
Optional Tab View hosts actual conversations, Browse pages, CUI apps, artifacts and safe GenUI. Spaces itself remains a tab; hiding the strip does not destroy tabs.

Show high-level thinking/work summaries, subagent task tree/detail, typed interactive output and live semantic Present/Canvas work. Completed/failed/approval-held states need their own truthful controls and artifact receipts.
Generated-file cards show name, owning app, revision, format and durable availability, with Open and eligible Download. Failed export shows the saved native artifacts and targeted retry.

Custom Space Builder has freely switchable Basic, Advanced and Expert tabs of one canonical Space. Basic/Advanced use a cohesive borderless configuration document; Expert uses Boards-style navigation for Details, Harness Logic, Model Logic, User Message Logic and Files.

Study Home, Subject Workspace and Study Session are separate active views within one Space/navigation scope. Restore the actual conversation/workspace when appropriate; do not stack a dashboard over an inactive editor. The default sidebar is New Chat; Subjects; Study Tools (My Progress, Planner, Revision Bank); Revise These; Recent Chats, under the shared customisation precedence.

Study Session exposes the four exact modes Learn, Practise, Test and Review near the standard composer, and a visible source-policy selector: My sources only / Wider knowledge allowed. Subject/topic, mode and policy remain legible without overwhelming the header. Switching mode preserves ConversationID, topic, sources, draft and voice/session state.
features: Submit only after admission succeeds; keep the draft when validation/admission fails. Steer affects future work, Queue preserves the queued message, and Stop reports actual stop acknowledgement rather than rewriting past outputs.

Respect per-Space default Steer/Queue policy and Alt+Enter inversion where the companion specifies it. A queued message must not be silently interpreted as a retroactive edit or immediate tool invocation.

Resolve +, @ and slash commands through canonical registered resource/invocation inventories. Passive mentions are references; explicit bounded commands execute only through real permission-aware APIs. Rich formatting and per-message Canvas composition preserve original message history.

Model effort labels bind directly to supported provider level IDs; they are neither quota nor confidence. Separate context and provider usage metrics, show unknown values honestly and hide inapplicable cloud allowance for local routes.

Chat Type and Chat Location are independent dimensions. Types are Normal, Multi-Agent and Temporary; locations are Local, Mesh and Cloud. Model execution location is separately governed from conversation storage.

Support approved conversions Temporary→Normal, Temporary→Multi-Agent and Normal→Multi-Agent without replaying tools or fabricating past participant replies. Temporary first becomes a durable local chat; Mesh/Cloud promotion is a separate authorised action. Unapproved reverse conversions are not silently added.

Chat Groups contains Group and Project organisation containers, not multi-agent chats and not new Spaces. Both reference canonical member conversations; Group adds shared instructions/relevant authorised context; Project additionally adds Sources, Rules and local/server/remote/cloud resource connections.
Group→Project is a one-way supported conversion preserving identity/history/members where safe; Project→Group is rejected. Removing a container does not silently delete its member chats.

Tasks defaults to the user’s own relevant task scope with explicit All Tasks filtering. Show objective, plan, steps, dependencies, blockers, approvals, source/outputs, real state and canonical task badges with accessible detail.

Study provides dashboard→subjects→subject/topics, source-backed tutor/practice and recorded progress. Revision Bank exposes Recommended, All, Flashcards, Notes, Papers and Quizzes, using Cards and Forms canonical artifacts. The older concept is a rough approved behaviour/layout reference under the current wrapper.

Assistant views open the global system’s permanent Main thread, additional conversations, Teams and work. Specialists launch the correct owned/available configured identity. These views do not replace Home/editor access to the global systems.

Research moves from initial conversation to reviewable plan, scope, sources and selected deliverables before Start. Quick/Extended/Deep/Custom modes use actual supported budgets; active execution time excludes waiting/paused periods and is not a completion guarantee.

Shopping combines natural-language control and conventional filters, distinguishes Required from Preferred constraints and exposes strict matches, alternatives/near matches and contextual recommendations with explicit reasons. Keep products separate from merchant offers, currency/price/freshness/source provenance visible, and purchase actions external and authorised.

Translate keeps language chips above the standard composer and one response bubble per target language, linked as sibling outputs in a TranslationSet. Route through real translation/model capabilities.

Experiences owns persistent world/scene, character, inventory, evidence, objectives, flags, checkpoints and branching state. Commit validated canonical state before narrating its outcome, enforce hidden-state visibility and retain recoverable checkpoints. Formal competition remains Play’s domain.

Basic configures name, description, icon, instructions, supported category availability and resources. Advanced adds Mandatory/Allowed/Blocked/Inherited capabilities, memory, genuine model parameters, Assistant/Specialist defaults, canonical Automations, theme/sidebar/message-control overrides and prompts.

Expert reuses the Home-owned Node Editor. Harness Logic configures permitted lifecycle/composer/sidebar/GenUI behaviour; Model Logic configures authorised routes/prompts/parameters; User Message Logic operates on derived representations without rewriting the immutable original message; Files is a real nested resource system.

Switching Builder tabs must preserve Expert-only nodes/behaviour and show Expert configurations active where simplified views cannot express it. Preview, Validate and Activate/Create are distinct; invalid drafts never replace the valid active graph. Templates and AI-assisted edits are inspectable starter changes, not implicit installed connections or automatic publication.

Typed GenUI is safely schema-bound and stateful. Open in App retains canonical identity. Live artifact work uses the owning app’s semantic edit APIs and any required review/approval rather than raw pointer simulation.

Subagent activity exposes delegation objective, current state, scope, blockers, outputs and high-level work events. Useful thinking summaries may show observed steps/tools/evidence but never private internal reasoning.

Study proficiency uses the four explicit labels Not assessed (neutral), Needs work (red), Developing (amber) and Confident (green), backed by attributable attempts and documented rules. Keep self-reported confidence separate from demonstrated proficiency; opening a lesson or flipping a card is not mastery evidence. Revise These ranks at most three distinct topics across all subjects using weak-first, then overdue/oldest-reviewed and stable TopicID ties, with an intelligible reason; unassessed is not weak.

Learn provides guided explanation; Practise records actual answers/working, hints and feedback; Test uses canonical Forms assessments with rubric/timing/provenance; Review uses recorded due/weak topics and Cards attempts. My sources only enforces the configured closed corpus and never fabricates citations. Revision Bank opens the real owning-app viewer/interactor with explicit Edit/Open in App; Study scheduling uses one canonical Planner Study burrow and proposes authorised review events rather than silently creating them.
entities: Persist SpaceID, configuration Draft/Active revisions, sidebar item IDs, ConversationID, immutable MessageID/history, group/project IDs and memberships, TabIDs, TaskID/RunID and attachment/source references.

Temporary chats remain local and do not automatically create/reinforce durable memory or transfer to Mesh/Cloud. Explicit conversion preserves history where safe. Open questions about optional existing-memory reads remain explicit until the owner resolves them.
Storage Local/Mesh/Cloud uses canonical LE-07 entitlement, quota, encryption, device, replication and conflict contracts. Choosing Local storage does not assert local inference.

Keep original full conversation history when context is compacted; summaries are derived with source provenance and eligibility. A context-window optimisation must not silently delete messages or output history.

Domain records remain owned by their actual apps/services: Cards/Forms study assets, Planner scheduling, Present/Canvas documents, Files resources, Automations triggers and global Assistant identities. Space folders/reference cards do not clone or move those objects.
Persist generated output artifacts and verified export manifests by canonical revision. A preview or completion sentence cannot create a downloadable file.

User-created Space settings and all three Builder projections share one SpaceID, graph, permissions, resources and history. Source references and imported packages retain canonical owner/version/trust metadata.
permissions: Conversation permissions narrow current use within durable grants; they cannot elevate app/org policy. Every consequential action still requires its applicable action approval, even if a category is available.

Voice toggle never silently enables camera/screen sharing. Persistent indicators reflect actual capture; Stop sharing must stop frames reaching the runtime. Open in Vision & Voice preserves the same session.

Group/Project sharing, multi-agent participation and context retrieval preserve provenance and participant/source permissions. Do not assume detailed turn-taking/human participation policy from the mere presence of a Multi-Agent label where source decisions remain open.

Builder validates mandatory-but-blocked conflicts, unavailable dependencies, typed ports, cycles/budgets, model capability, CUI safety and effective policy. Imported Skills/Plugins/MCP/models/mini apps are validated through their owners, never auto-trusted by folder membership.

An invalid generated component preserves prior valid content and offers repair. A failed PDF/export preserves the saved native artifact and retries only that export from the selected revision; repeated retry must not duplicate earlier external effects.
Tab close/back respects dirty state and preserves background runs. Revoked resources are redacted from cached display/retrieval; unavailable contexts show recoverable state without discarding drafts.

Peer Review limits count aggregate reviewer active time against measured productive worker active time, not wall-clock waiting or duplicated simultaneous worker clocks. Exhaustion never bypasses a required permission/review gate.
acceptance: Create a Chat, attach a permitted canonical source, type rich content, switch Space/sidebar/tab and return with the same draft/focus. Verify failed admission retains the draft and queued/steered work follows the configured semantics.
Test Normal/Multi-Agent/Temporary, all approved conversions, denied reverse conversion, Local/Mesh/Cloud eligibility, temporary memory/transfer restrictions and no tool replay.
Create Group and Project containers, share scoped context, convert Group→Project and reject downgrade; remove a container without losing member conversations.

Exercise Study topic→tutor/practice→Revision Bank/Cards/Forms, Research review/start/results, Shopping Required/Preferred filtering, Translate sibling language outputs and Experiences checkpoint recovery.
Open global Assistant Main work in Spaces and an editor; verify identity, grants and task references match. Exercise a child task blocked on approval, parent cancellation and partial sibling outputs.

Interact with a typed GenUI control, watch actual semantic Present/Canvas changes, open the same saved artifact and download only verified bytes. Force export failure and recover without losing native content.

Test the floating Summary and Voice pill together with no blocked controls; camera/screen sharing require explicit grant and ending them stops runtime capture. Verify accessible keyboard/touch/narrow layouts and reduced motion.

Switch Basic/Advanced/Expert repeatedly after creating Expert-only logic; verify the same SpaceID, graph and draft/active revision, inspectable conflicts, genuine nested resources and safe preview/activation.
Use independent real runtime evidence for acceptance. These mock-ups and primary rules do not assert that any Space is complete or that backend acceptance has passed.

Exercise all four Study modes in the same conversation, enforce both source policies, inspect Not assessed/Needs work/Developing/Confident evidence, and verify self-confidence does not itself change demonstrated proficiency. Across multiple subjects show no more than three ranked recommendations; open a canonical Forms/Cards resource and a Planner Study-burrow event without duplicate stores or false mastery.

screens.title: Study · Session modes and source policy
screens.source: Study Space detailed interface specification, effective 13 October 2026: STUDY-UI-202, 205, 210–220; LE-08–10; UX27-SPACES-005–007
notes: The contextual Learn / Practise / Test / Review selector changes the next request in this same Study session. Preserve ConversationID, message history, TopicID, selected sources, answer draft and meaningful mode-transition provenance.

Practise records a real submitted attempt with question/source reference, working, feedback, marking provenance and hint conditions. This displayed question is unanswered; no new proficiency or completed review is implied. Learn worked examples and Review page opens or card flips are not assessed evidence.

Test uses the canonical Forms Test/Quiz assessment engine with inspectable rules, rubric and supported marking policy. Choosing Test alone does not start a timer, fabricate a grade or copy the assessment into a private Study database.

My sources only applies the configured closed-corpus policy. Wider knowledge allowed distinguishes authorised supplied material, external research and general explanation; citations cannot be fabricated and higher-priority web/account permissions still apply. Switching cannot rewrite the provenance of earlier answers.

Topic proficiency uses Not assessed, Needs work, Developing and Confident. It derives from attributed evidence and review rules. The separate self-reported confidence control never silently changes demonstrated proficiency or another learner’s private records.

The current Study wrapper, shared model/effort route, conversation-permissions icon and rounded icon-only Send/Voice shelf remain in place. Voice and multimodal capture use the shared Vision & Voice APIs. Local selectors in this reference preserve the draft and do not execute or mark an answer.

# Spaces — conversations, workspaces and custom Space Builder

Module ID: `spaces` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Dulche runtime, requests and execution services** — Canonical AI broker, capability-aware routing, durable Task/Runs, action execution and lifecycle.
- **Node Editor — shared graph framework** — Shared typed graph schemas, editing/validation, draft activation and runtime presentation.
- **Global Assistants, Specialists and collaborators** — Persistent global Assistant/Specialist identities, Teams, canonical conversations and editor collaboration.
- **Subagents, delegation and task trees** — Durable delegated task trees, inherited scope, bounded budgets, joins and recovery.
- **Generative UI and live artifact output** — Safe typed generated components, canonical live artifacts and verified durable output/export cards.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.
- **Permissions, approvals and execution scope** — Effective scoped grants, action approvals, policy intersections, revocation and audit.
- **Models, discovery and universal model routing** — Model discovery/lifecycle, stable provider capabilities, ordered routing and truthful usage/effort metadata.
- **Vision & Voice — shared live session system** — Vision & Voice owns real conversational speech, visual context and live translation services, reused by the in-chat Voice pill. Multiple surfaces attach to the same session rather than creating a second speech/capture stack.

## Overview

Spaces is the conversation and task workspace for Chat, Tasks, Study, Assistant conversation views, Research, Shopping, Translate and Experiences, plus user-created Spaces. Each Space has a real domain workflow. Global Assistants/Specialists retain canonical identities outside Spaces, while their conversation views and work remain accessible here. This chapter is a copyable implementation unit; its prerequisite contracts define shared services, and the retained technical chunks preserve the full baseline and confirmed companion.

Current owner overrides: V3-OWNER-001, V3-OWNER-002, V3-OWNER-006, V3-OWNER-008, V3-OWNER-017.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-SPACES-LAY-01** — The far-left rail switches stable Space destinations and includes Manage Spaces; support the existing rail/dropdown preference, pinning, reorder and discovery. The contextual sidebar is independently collapsible/customisable with Space Overrides > User Preferences > Default precedence.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-02** — Preserve active conversation, draft, selection, scroll, voice/session and Task/Run across Space switching. On narrow screens use responsive drawers with a durable reopen affordance rather than squeezing desktop columns.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-03** — Chat is a Space, not a separate app. Default Chat sidebar sections may include New Chat, Chat Groups, Specialists and Recent Chats; they are defaults, not a fixed mandatory ordering.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-04** — Keep conversation readable with distinct user/AI provenance. Plain Text/Speech Bubbles and alignment remain preferences. The current Professional wrapper and authoritative slides govern current chrome, not the older later-slide diagrams.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-05** — The compact/expanded composer has + attachment/resource access, editable draft, focus-aware Aa and native emoji, model/effort context and state-appropriate send/voice controls. Keep attachment/plugin chips identity-backed, inspectable and scoped.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-06** — Place a Conversation permissions icon in the composer; it is not the editor Read-only/Write switch. Its panel shows files/apps/web/memory scope and links to Manage app permissions.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-07** — The contextual option shelf shows at most five current choices plus a peek, navigation/dots and truthful selection; browsing choices does not submit the draft.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-08** — Idle controls expose Send/Voice; an empty disabled Send still permits Voice. Running work exposes Steer, Stop, Queue and Voice as supported; paused work exposes Resume/End Pass and approval-held work shows the actual pending decision.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-09** — Summary is an optional floating top-right widget with Activity, Outputs and Sources. It must not become a permanent fourth column or shrink the conversation; keep required controls uncovered.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-10** — Voice mode is a floating icon-first pill within Chat over the same canonical Vision & Voice session. Include mute, screen sharing, camera, captions, pause/resume, end, current voice/mode and more settings with permission indicators.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-11** — Optional Tab View hosts actual conversations, Browse pages, CUI apps, artifacts and safe GenUI. Spaces itself remains a tab; hiding the strip does not destroy tabs.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-12** — Show high-level thinking/work summaries, subagent task tree/detail, typed interactive output and live semantic Present/Canvas work. Completed/failed/approval-held states need their own truthful controls and artifact receipts.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-13** — Generated-file cards show name, owning app, revision, format and durable availability, with Open and eligible Download. Failed export shows the saved native artifacts and targeted retry.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-14** — Custom Space Builder has freely switchable Basic, Advanced and Expert tabs of one canonical Space. Basic/Advanced use a cohesive borderless configuration document; Expert uses Boards-style navigation for Details, Harness Logic, Model Logic, User Message Logic and Files.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-15** — Study Home, Subject Workspace and Study Session are separate active views within one Space/navigation scope. Restore the actual conversation/workspace when appropriate; do not stack a dashboard over an inactive editor. The default sidebar is New Chat; Subjects; Study Tools (My Progress, Planner, Revision Bank); Revise These; Recent Chats, under the shared customisation precedence.
- **V3-SPACES-LAY-16** — Study Session exposes the four exact modes Learn, Practise, Test and Review near the standard composer, and a visible source-policy selector: My sources only / Wider knowledge allowed. Subject/topic, mode and policy remain legible without overwhelming the header. Switching mode preserves ConversationID, topic, sources, draft and voice/session state.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-SPACES-FEA-01** — Submit only after admission succeeds; keep the draft when validation/admission fails. Steer affects future work, Queue preserves the queued message, and Stop reports actual stop acknowledgement rather than rewriting past outputs.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-02** — Respect per-Space default Steer/Queue policy and Alt+Enter inversion where the companion specifies it. A queued message must not be silently interpreted as a retroactive edit or immediate tool invocation.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-03** — Resolve +, @ and slash commands through canonical registered resource/invocation inventories. Passive mentions are references; explicit bounded commands execute only through real permission-aware APIs. Rich formatting and per-message Canvas composition preserve original message history.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-04** — Model effort labels bind directly to supported provider level IDs; they are neither quota nor confidence. Separate context and provider usage metrics, show unknown values honestly and hide inapplicable cloud allowance for local routes.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-05** — Chat Type and Chat Location are independent dimensions. Types are Normal, Multi-Agent and Temporary; locations are Local, Mesh and Cloud. Model execution location is separately governed from conversation storage.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-06** — Support approved conversions Temporary→Normal, Temporary→Multi-Agent and Normal→Multi-Agent without replaying tools or fabricating past participant replies. Temporary first becomes a durable local chat; Mesh/Cloud promotion is a separate authorised action. Unapproved reverse conversions are not silently added.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-07** — Chat Groups contains Group and Project organisation containers, not multi-agent chats and not new Spaces. Both reference canonical member conversations; Group adds shared instructions/relevant authorised context; Project additionally adds Sources, Rules and local/server/remote/cloud resource connections.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-08** — Group→Project is a one-way supported conversion preserving identity/history/members where safe; Project→Group is rejected. Removing a container does not silently delete its member chats.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-09** — Tasks defaults to the user’s own relevant task scope with explicit All Tasks filtering. Show objective, plan, steps, dependencies, blockers, approvals, source/outputs, real state and canonical task badges with accessible detail.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-10** — Study provides dashboard→subjects→subject/topics, source-backed tutor/practice and recorded progress. Revision Bank exposes Recommended, All, Flashcards, Notes, Papers and Quizzes, using Cards and Forms canonical artifacts. The older concept is a rough approved behaviour/layout reference under the current wrapper.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-11** — Assistant views open the global system’s permanent Main thread, additional conversations, Teams and work. Specialists launch the correct owned/available configured identity. These views do not replace Home/editor access to the global systems.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-12** — Research moves from initial conversation to reviewable plan, scope, sources and selected deliverables before Start. Quick/Extended/Deep/Custom modes use actual supported budgets; active execution time excludes waiting/paused periods and is not a completion guarantee.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-13** — Shopping combines natural-language control and conventional filters, distinguishes Required from Preferred constraints and exposes strict matches, alternatives/near matches and contextual recommendations with explicit reasons. Keep products separate from merchant offers, currency/price/freshness/source provenance visible, and purchase actions external and authorised.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-14** — Translate keeps language chips above the standard composer and one response bubble per target language, linked as sibling outputs in a TranslationSet. Route through real translation/model capabilities.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-15** — Experiences owns persistent world/scene, character, inventory, evidence, objectives, flags, checkpoints and branching state. Commit validated canonical state before narrating its outcome, enforce hidden-state visibility and retain recoverable checkpoints. Formal competition remains Play’s domain.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-16** — Basic configures name, description, icon, instructions, supported category availability and resources. Advanced adds Mandatory/Allowed/Blocked/Inherited capabilities, memory, genuine model parameters, Assistant/Specialist defaults, canonical Automations, theme/sidebar/message-control overrides and prompts.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-17** — Expert reuses the Home-owned Node Editor. Harness Logic configures permitted lifecycle/composer/sidebar/GenUI behaviour; Model Logic configures authorised routes/prompts/parameters; User Message Logic operates on derived representations without rewriting the immutable original message; Files is a real nested resource system.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-18** — Switching Builder tabs must preserve Expert-only nodes/behaviour and show Expert configurations active where simplified views cannot express it. Preview, Validate and Activate/Create are distinct; invalid drafts never replace the valid active graph. Templates and AI-assisted edits are inspectable starter changes, not implicit installed connections or automatic publication.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-19** — Typed GenUI is safely schema-bound and stateful. Open in App retains canonical identity. Live artifact work uses the owning app’s semantic edit APIs and any required review/approval rather than raw pointer simulation.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-20** — Subagent activity exposes delegation objective, current state, scope, blockers, outputs and high-level work events. Useful thinking summaries may show observed steps/tools/evidence but never private internal reasoning.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-21** — Study proficiency uses the four explicit labels Not assessed (neutral), Needs work (red), Developing (amber) and Confident (green), backed by attributable attempts and documented rules. Keep self-reported confidence separate from demonstrated proficiency; opening a lesson or flipping a card is not mastery evidence. Revise These ranks at most three distinct topics across all subjects using weak-first, then overdue/oldest-reviewed and stable TopicID ties, with an intelligible reason; unassessed is not weak.
- **V3-SPACES-FEA-22** — Learn provides guided explanation; Practise records actual answers/working, hints and feedback; Test uses canonical Forms assessments with rubric/timing/provenance; Review uses recorded due/weak topics and Cards attempts. My sources only enforces the configured closed corpus and never fabricates citations. Revision Bank opens the real owning-app viewer/interactor with explicit Edit/Open in App; Study scheduling uses one canonical Planner Study burrow and proposes authorised review events rather than silently creating them.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-SPACES-ENT-01** — Persist SpaceID, configuration Draft/Active revisions, sidebar item IDs, ConversationID, immutable MessageID/history, group/project IDs and memberships, TabIDs, TaskID/RunID and attachment/source references.
- **V3-SPACES-ENT-02** — Temporary chats remain local and do not automatically create/reinforce durable memory or transfer to Mesh/Cloud. Explicit conversion preserves history where safe. Open questions about optional existing-memory reads remain explicit until the owner resolves them.
- **V3-SPACES-ENT-03** — Storage Local/Mesh/Cloud uses canonical LE-07 entitlement, quota, encryption, device, replication and conflict contracts. Choosing Local storage does not assert local inference.
- **V3-SPACES-ENT-04** — Keep original full conversation history when context is compacted; summaries are derived with source provenance and eligibility. A context-window optimisation must not silently delete messages or output history.
- **V3-SPACES-ENT-05** — Domain records remain owned by their actual apps/services: Cards/Forms study assets, Planner scheduling, Present/Canvas documents, Files resources, Automations triggers and global Assistant identities. Space folders/reference cards do not clone or move those objects.
- **V3-SPACES-ENT-06** — Persist generated output artifacts and verified export manifests by canonical revision. A preview or completion sentence cannot create a downloadable file.
- **V3-SPACES-ENT-07** — User-created Space settings and all three Builder projections share one SpaceID, graph, permissions, resources and history. Source references and imported packages retain canonical owner/version/trust metadata.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-SPACES-PER-01** — Conversation permissions narrow current use within durable grants; they cannot elevate app/org policy. Every consequential action still requires its applicable action approval, even if a category is available.
- **V3-SPACES-PER-02** — Voice toggle never silently enables camera/screen sharing. Persistent indicators reflect actual capture; Stop sharing must stop frames reaching the runtime. Open in Vision & Voice preserves the same session.
- **V3-SPACES-PER-03** — Group/Project sharing, multi-agent participation and context retrieval preserve provenance and participant/source permissions. Do not assume detailed turn-taking/human participation policy from the mere presence of a Multi-Agent label where source decisions remain open.
- **V3-SPACES-PER-04** — Builder validates mandatory-but-blocked conflicts, unavailable dependencies, typed ports, cycles/budgets, model capability, CUI safety and effective policy. Imported Skills/Plugins/MCP/models/mini apps are validated through their owners, never auto-trusted by folder membership.
- **V3-SPACES-PER-05** — An invalid generated component preserves prior valid content and offers repair. A failed PDF/export preserves the saved native artifact and retries only that export from the selected revision; repeated retry must not duplicate earlier external effects.
- **V3-SPACES-PER-06** — Tab close/back respects dirty state and preserves background runs. Revoked resources are redacted from cached display/retrieval; unavailable contexts show recoverable state without discarding drafts.
- **V3-SPACES-PER-07** — Peer Review limits count aggregate reviewer active time against measured productive worker active time, not wall-clock waiting or duplicated simultaneous worker clocks. Exhaustion never bypasses a required permission/review gate.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-SPACES-ACC-01** — Create a Chat, attach a permitted canonical source, type rich content, switch Space/sidebar/tab and return with the same draft/focus. Verify failed admission retains the draft and queued/steered work follows the configured semantics.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-02** — Test Normal/Multi-Agent/Temporary, all approved conversions, denied reverse conversion, Local/Mesh/Cloud eligibility, temporary memory/transfer restrictions and no tool replay.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-03** — Create Group and Project containers, share scoped context, convert Group→Project and reject downgrade; remove a container without losing member conversations.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-04** — Exercise Study topic→tutor/practice→Revision Bank/Cards/Forms, Research review/start/results, Shopping Required/Preferred filtering, Translate sibling language outputs and Experiences checkpoint recovery.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-05** — Open global Assistant Main work in Spaces and an editor; verify identity, grants and task references match. Exercise a child task blocked on approval, parent cancellation and partial sibling outputs.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-06** — Interact with a typed GenUI control, watch actual semantic Present/Canvas changes, open the same saved artifact and download only verified bytes. Force export failure and recover without losing native content.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-07** — Test the floating Summary and Voice pill together with no blocked controls; camera/screen sharing require explicit grant and ending them stops runtime capture. Verify accessible keyboard/touch/narrow layouts and reduced motion.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-08** — Switch Basic/Advanced/Expert repeatedly after creating Expert-only logic; verify the same SpaceID, graph and draft/active revision, inspectable conflicts, genuine nested resources and safe preview/activation.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-09** — Use independent real runtime evidence for acceptance. These mock-ups and primary rules do not assert that any Space is complete or that backend acceptance has passed.
- **V3-SPACES-ACC-10** — Exercise all four Study modes in the same conversation, enforce both source policies, inspect Not assessed/Needs work/Developing/Confident evidence, and verify self-confidence does not itself change demonstrated proficiency. Across multiple subjects show no more than three ranked recommendations; open a canonical Forms/Cards resource and a Planner Study-burrow event without duplicate stores or false mastery.

## Exact mock-up and state map

# Write — document authoring

Module ID: `write` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Shared productivity engine and canonical embeds** — Real document/object engines, semantic editing, canonical app embedding and donor feature parity.
- **Shared AI controls and artifact collaboration** — Contextual AI bars, shared model/permission controls, global collaborators and typed artifact proposals.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.

## Overview

Write is a full document editor with a restrained contextual shell. Continuous, Pages and Book are genuine presentations of the same document, retaining substantive Writer/donor capability and canonical document semantics.

Current owner overrides: V3-OWNER-012.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-WRITE-LAY-01** — Use Home/title/save-state header, nested Sections outline and one contextual floating formatting toolbar. Persistent insert, view/eye and more controls remain discoverable; do not add an Office-style ribbon.
- **V3-WRITE-LAY-02** — Continuous is the default flowing document view. Pages shows real page boundaries and pagination; Book shows the supported facing-page reading/editing arrangement. Selecting a layout does not create a different document.
- **V3-WRITE-LAY-03** — Provide selected text/object, insertion picker, typing, comments/history, formatting/property and collaborator review states. Keep the AI bar separate from page content and bottom controls.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-WRITE-FEA-01** — Support rich text/styles, structured sections, tables, objects, references, fields, comments, tracked suggestions, pagination and exports through the retained full engine contract.
- **V3-WRITE-FEA-02** — Edit/Suggest/View, layout lock and AI Read-only/Write are independent controls. A locked layout is not necessarily a read-only document, and AI Write does not bypass suggestions or document permission.
- **V3-WRITE-FEA-03** — Paragraph/character formatting acts on the actual selection with inspectable defaults. Caret/focus and undo survive toolbar/menu use.
- **V3-WRITE-FEA-04** — Global Assistant/Specialist collaborators create typed revision-bound changes with review, accept/reject and clear authorship.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-WRITE-ENT-01** — Persist DocumentID, section/block/object IDs, text ranges, styles, revision, comments/suggestions and layout configuration. Layout view state is separate from authored content.
- **V3-WRITE-ENT-02** — Keep native document content authoritative; previews and exported PDF/other formats are derived from a known revision.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-WRITE-PER-01** — Respect document and source permissions. A stale collaborator proposal requires reconciliation rather than overwriting intervening edits.
- **V3-WRITE-PER-02** — Autosave/reopen and failed export preserve the native document and meaningful undo/history.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-WRITE-ACC-01** — Test typing/selection/formatting/insertion, nested Sections and switching Continuous/Pages/Book with unchanged content.
- **V3-WRITE-ACC-02** — Verify Edit/Suggest/View versus AI scope, locked layout, collaborator review, page/export correctness and recovery.

## Exact mock-up and state map

- **Write · Start** — screen `write-launch`. Launch.
- **Write · Page View** — screen `write-editor`. Pages & properties.
- **Write · Continuous View** — screen `write-continuous`. Pageless writing.
- **Write · Selection & review** — screen `write-review`. Suggested change.
- **Write · Invite collaborators** — screen `write-collaborators-picker`. Assistant & Specialist picker.
- **Write · Working with collaborators** — screen `write-collaborators`. Presence & scoped work.

Suggest edits is the granted scope here. Write in the contextual AI bar does not waive range limits, current ACLs or review; a proposal remains unapplied until the user accepts the exact change.
Pause and Stop are visible for the run and individual workers. Stop cancels future work, retains checkpoints/proposals and never silently reverts already committed edits.

# Present — slide authoring and presentation

Module ID: `present` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Shared productivity engine and canonical embeds** — Real document/object engines, semantic editing, canonical app embedding and donor feature parity.
- **Node Editor — shared graph framework** — Shared typed graph schemas, editing/validation, draft activation and runtime presentation.
- **Shared AI controls and artifact collaboration** — Contextual AI bars, shared model/permission controls, global collaborators and typed artifact proposals.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.

## Overview

Present provides full slide authoring, object editing, actions/animation and presentation playback. The Professional annex and authoritative slide 16 define its clean three-tier editing shell and object-selection behaviour.

Current owner overrides: V3-OWNER-001, V3-OWNER-013.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-PRESENT-LAY-01** — Use document header, File/Edit/Insert/Slide/Arrange/View/Help menu row and a single floating contextual toolbar. Thumbnails occupy the left, aspect-correct slide dominates, notes sit below and an optional right inspector follows selection.
- **V3-PRESENT-LAY-02** — Object selection shows eight resize handles and rotation; text editing shows a real caret/range. Do not confuse selected shape with text-entry mode.
- **V3-PRESENT-LAY-03** — Include Shapes, custom shape creation/editing, Actions and presentation/playback states. Custom shapes need real path/geometry editing rather than a static gallery label.
- **V3-PRESENT-LAY-04** — Presenter view keeps notes and next-slide/control information private from the audience display. Notes are editable content, not a decorative placeholder.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-PRESENT-FEA-01** — Maintain slide order/layouts/masters, text/shapes/media, object alignment/arrangement, notes, animation, action graph and playback through canonical semantics.
- **V3-PRESENT-FEA-02** — Action configuration identifies trigger, target, effect, transition/navigation or permitted external action and preview behaviour. Use the shared Node Editor where source-defined graph authoring applies.
- **V3-PRESENT-FEA-03** — Preserve pointer transforms at zoom and viewport changes, selection geometry, keyboard nudge, proportional resizing and real undo.
- **V3-PRESENT-FEA-04** — Global collaborators expose typed changes to this deck/selected slide with review and expected revision. Live work from Spaces opens the same deck.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-PRESENT-ENT-01** — Keep DeckID, SlideID, object IDs, geometry, text/style, note content, action/animation definitions, revision and playback state distinct.
- **V3-PRESENT-ENT-02** — Export and audience rendering use the chosen slide size and content revision; app theme never retints authored slides.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-PRESENT-PER-01** — Preview/presentation mode must not grant document-write or external-action permission. Publishing/exporting remains a separate operation with truthful state.
- **V3-PRESENT-PER-02** — Preserve native deck when an export fails; reconcile stale collaborative changes and recover unsaved selection/edit state.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-PRESENT-ACC-01** — Test selection versus caret, all handles/rotation at zoom, slide reorder, notes, custom shape edit and Actions configuration.
- **V3-PRESENT-ACC-02** — Verify presenter notes remain private, authored colours survive all themes, and live Spaces work/collaborator review references the same deck revision.

# Canvas — drawing, objects and semantic composition

Module ID: `canvas` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Shared productivity engine and canonical embeds** — Real document/object engines, semantic editing, canonical app embedding and donor feature parity.
- **Shared AI controls and artifact collaboration** — Contextual AI bars, shared model/permission controls, global collaborators and typed artifact proposals.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.

## Overview

Canvas is a real drawing/composition workspace with shared object, vector/raster and ink semantics. Its dominant work surface uses a compact top identity and a focused bottom tool system.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-CANVAS-LAY-01** — Use bottom Select, Pan, Pen, Eraser, Insert, Tools and AI controls, with one contextual options row for the active tool. Keep compact name/menu/quick settings above the work surface.
- **V3-CANVAS-LAY-02** — Show object selection, pen width/colour, insert and contextual AI states. AI appears above the bottom toolbar and must not cover active controls.
- **V3-CANVAS-LAY-03** — Live Spaces work shows semantic object/stroke progress on the same Canvas artifact, not a screenshot replacing the editor.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-CANVAS-FEA-01** — Support actual object/stroke selection, grouping, geometry transforms, connectors, drawing/erasing and source-defined hybrid raster/vector operations.
- **V3-CANVAS-FEA-02** — Tool changes preserve selection and undo; coordinate transforms stay correct at pan/zoom and responsive dimensions.
- **V3-CANVAS-FEA-03** — Semantic AI edits use selected object/context IDs with preview/approval and preserve authored content colours across themes.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-CANVAS-ENT-01** — Persist CanvasID, object/stroke/layer IDs, geometry, z-order, grouping/connector relationships, styles and revisions.
- **V3-CANVAS-ENT-02** — Viewport pan/zoom and transient tool settings are separate from authored state and generated export bytes.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-CANVAS-PER-01** — Enforce artifact/embedded source permissions and revision checks. A failed render/export leaves the native canvas recoverable.
- **V3-CANVAS-PER-02** — Reconnect to live work without duplicating strokes/objects or replaying already-committed actions.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-CANVAS-ACC-01** — Test drawing, selection/grouping, erase, connectors, transforms and undo at several zoom levels.
- **V3-CANVAS-ACC-02** — Verify toolbar/AI separation, semantic live work from Spaces, theme-stable art and saved/exported revision identity.

Module ID: `picture` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Shared productivity engine and canonical embeds** — Real document/object engines, semantic editing, canonical app embedding and donor feature parity.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.
- **Shared AI controls and artifact collaboration** — Contextual AI bars, shared model/permission controls, global collaborators and typed artifact proposals.

## Overview

Picture is a full image editor with source-defined raster/vector, selection, layer, mask and adjustment capabilities. The CUI shell wraps the real engine and retains its substantive editing power.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-PICTURE-LAY-01** — Use a dominant image canvas, purposeful tool rail and layers/properties context. Selected layer, selection marquee, crop/transform and adjustment controls must correspond to actual document state.
- **V3-PICTURE-LAY-02** — Show destructive/non-destructive operation, generated layer and pending/failed export states clearly.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-PICTURE-FEA-01** — Support layer ordering/visibility/opacity, masks, selections, drawing, vector/raster transforms, crop/resize and adjustments from the retained donor contract.
- **V3-PICTURE-FEA-02** — AI edits are typed, revision-bound proposals or generated content with preserved original/source metadata and meaningful undo.
- **V3-PICTURE-FEA-03** — Export exposes actual format/colour/transparency and dimensional constraints; a preview thumbnail is not exported bytes.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-PICTURE-ENT-01** — Persist image/document ID, layer/mask/selection/vector IDs, pixel resources, transforms, adjustments, colour metadata and revision.
- **V3-PICTURE-ENT-02** — Derived previews/proxies and export records reference the native content revision.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-PICTURE-PER-01** — Respect source image ownership and current edit grants. Preserve native layers when a derived export fails.
- **V3-PICTURE-PER-02** — Recover interrupted processing and prevent stale AI results from overwriting intervening edits.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-PICTURE-ACC-01** — Test selection→layer/mask/adjustment→transform→undo and native reopen with identical structure.
- **V3-PICTURE-ACC-02** — Verify transparent/format export options, source preservation, AI review and failed-render recovery.

## Exact mock-up and state map

- **Picture · Layered composition** — screen `picture`. Editor.
- **Picture · Layer mask editing** — screen `picture-mask`. Interaction state.
- **Picture · Export image** — screen `picture-export`. Interaction state.

# Mini Computer — VM and remote desktop control

Module ID: `mini-computer` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Permissions, approvals and execution scope** — Effective scoped grants, action approvals, policy intersections, revocation and audit.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.

## Overview

Mini Computer displays and controls a real VM/device session through the supported backend. Input ownership, resource configuration and close-versus-stop semantics remain explicit.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-LAY-01** — Provide authentic desktop viewport with visible target/session/runtime state. Show View only versus Control and the current input owner.
- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-LAY-02** — Keep connection, scaling/full-screen, clipboard/file transfer, snapshot/resource and power controls discoverable without confusing window close with machine stop.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-FEA-01** — Use the actual VM/viewer/input backend, supported guest capabilities and runtime versions. Control grants gate keyboard/pointer delivery.
- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-FEA-02** — Configure resources and snapshots with defined powered-state constraints. Closing the viewer detaches; stopping/shutting down affects the machine and requires the corresponding action.
- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-FEA-03** — Clipboard/file sharing and AI computer interaction are separately permissioned capabilities; a visible desktop does not grant either automatically.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-ENT-01** — Persist machine/session IDs, configuration, supported runtime, disk/snapshot references, connection and input-ownership state.
- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-ENT-02** — Viewer pan/scale/full-screen is transient; guest process and machine lifecycle continue according to runtime state.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-PER-01** — Respect device/VM scope and input ownership, handle lost control and disconnect visibly, and revoke input immediately when required.
- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-PER-02** — Recover reconnect and snapshot/stop failures without claiming the machine is stopped or unchanged until confirmed.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-ACC-01** — Test view-only→control grant, input routing, revoke control, close viewer and explicit stop as separate outcomes.
- **V3-MINI-COMPUTER-ACC-02** — Verify resource/snapshot constraints, clipboard/file permission and disconnected recovery.

# Delivery governance and historical process

Module ID: `delivery` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **Authority, scope and implementation reading map** — Current source precedence, narrow owner overrides, source accounting and the required module structure.

## Overview

This module retains product-delivery constraints and historical process provenance without promoting expired schedules or agent-operation instructions into current authorisation. Future/deferred scope remains clearly separate from the current release contract.

Current owner overrides: V3-RECON-002.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-DELIVERY-LAY-01** — Documentation exposes current implementation/verification status honestly. A design mock-up, planned feature or compiling placeholder is not labelled complete functionality.
- **V3-DELIVERY-LAY-02** — Keep deferred Training Lab/Android-ROM expansion and undefined capabilities visibly out of current acceptance claims.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-DELIVERY-FEA-01** — Preserve retained source, licensing, donor parity, migration and quality requirements that affect the product deliverable.
- **V3-DELIVERY-FEA-02** — Historical deadlines, worker schedules and operational handoff instructions are archived with their source IDs and original wording, not followed as new tasks.
- **V3-DELIVERY-FEA-03** — Use module/source traceability to identify implementation work and unresolved dependencies; do not silently redefine completed scope from a visual review.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-DELIVERY-ENT-01** — Maintain versioned source/override ledgers, module boundaries and acceptance evidence references. Original source bytes remain available for audit.
- **V3-DELIVERY-ENT-02** — Distinguish planned, implemented, tested and independently accepted status records.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-DELIVERY-PER-01** — External deployment, spending and communication still require the operation’s current authority; historical prose is not authorisation.
- **V3-DELIVERY-PER-02** — Record unresolved contradictions or absent references rather than inventing missing backend guarantees.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-DELIVERY-ACC-01** — Check historical process is excluded from active technical execution instructions while substantive product requirements remain retained.
- **V3-DELIVERY-ACC-02** — Verify future/deferred scope is not shown as implemented or accepted.

## Exact mock-up and state map

This is a shared contract or backend module. Its visible implementation is exercised by dependent app screens rather than a new standalone application.

# Cross-app acceptance and evidence

Module ID: `acceptance` · 9to1 Development Specification v3

## Prerequisites

- **Authority, scope and implementation reading map** — Current source precedence, narrow owner overrides, source accounting and the required module structure.
- **Platform, app registry and host integration** — Canonical app registry, artifact routes, native/browser embedding, lifecycle and semantic UI/API parity.
- **CUI, themes and shared interaction system** — Typed UI components, theme tokens/materials, layout, focus, motion, accessibility and shared control states.
- **Permissions, approvals and execution scope** — Effective scoped grants, action approvals, policy intersections, revocation and audit.
- **Artifacts, local persistence and recovery** — Canonical artifacts, revisions, typed edits, local saves, derived exports, sync and recovery.

## Overview

Acceptance verifies real behaviour, compatibility, permission boundaries and recovery across apps. The supplied scenario chapters remain retained; mock-up review and source coverage are design evidence only.

## Layouts & visible states

- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-LAY-01** — Exercise actual screens at supported desktop, narrow/mobile and native/browser/OS hosts, including focus, scroll, popup placement, contrast and reduced motion.
- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-LAY-02** — Include real empty/loading/unavailable/permission/approval/error/conflict and recovery states, not only the attractive success screenshot.

## Features & behaviour

- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-FEA-01** — Run source-backed end-to-end scenarios through canonical APIs and visible UI. Evidence must connect requested action, actual state mutation/result, persisted reopen and meaningful failure handling.
- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-FEA-02** — Validate UI/API parity, app ownership, shared theme consistency, local/manual workflows and donor feature coverage where required.
- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-FEA-03** — Shared prerequisite tests may be reused with explicit version/evidence references; do not substitute a shallow screenshot test for substantive backend behaviour.

## Canonical entities & persistence

- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-ENT-01** — Record test/scenario IDs, build/version, environment, input/target revision, observed result and evidence. Preserve failed/partial outcomes distinctly from pass.
- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-ENT-02** — Source acceptance IDs remain stable for traceability even when current UI placement changes.

## Permissions & recovery

- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-PER-01** — Permission/security and independent-review gates remain mandatory; time/review budget exhaustion cannot turn an untested result into VERIFIED.
- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-PER-02** — Reruns and test fixtures must not repeat consequential real external actions without their defined safe test scope.

## Acceptance checks

- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-ACC-01** — Cover canonical artifact opened in multiple hosts, offline/restart, grant revocation, concurrent revision, failure/retry and derived export verification.
- **V3-ACCEPTANCE-ACC-02** — Reconcile every current module’s acceptance list with retained source scenarios and explicitly document gaps rather than asserting completeness from the atlas.
